description: This file defines a NotesRepository interface and its implementation NotesRepositoryImpl for managing 'Note' objects, including operations such as getAll, search, get by id, save, and delete. The implementation interacts with a local database via DAO (Data Access Object) classes. The classes handle mapping between domain models and database records.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: An interface providing an abstraction for notes data source operations, including retrieving all notes, searching, getting by id, saving, and deletion.

classes.name: NotesRepositoryImpl
classes.description: A concrete implementation of NotesRepository backed by a local SQLite database via DAO classes, handling domain-model to database-record conversions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes, ordered by last updated, via DAO.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches notes by text query via DAO.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a note; inserts if new or updates if existing, returning the note's id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, returning true if successful.

methods.name: NoteRecord.toDomain
methods.description: Converts a database record to a domain Note object.

methods.name: Note.toRecord
methods.description: Converts a domain Note object to a database record, setting timestamps appropriately.

methods.name: Note.toRecordWithId
methods.description: Converts a domain Note object to a database record with an existing ID, setting timestamps appropriately.
